# AI Harness — Copilot / Codex Instructions

## Context
Read steering/project.md and
steering/conventions.md before acting.

## Conventions
- Naming: kebab-case files, snake_case
  config, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE env vars.
  (see conventions/naming.md)
- Error handling: fail fast, structured
  logs, no silent swallows.
  (see conventions/error-handling.md)
- API: URL versioning, Bearer auth,
  idempotent writes.
  (see conventions/api-design.md)
- Testing: 80%+ new, 95%+ payment/auth.
  (see conventions/testing.md)

## Skills available
- code-review: on PR open or /review.
  See skills/code-review/SKILL.md.
- migration: on /migrate or data-model
  PR. See skills/migration/SKILL.md.
- incident-response: on /incident or
  SEV-1/2. See skills/incident-response/SKILL.md.
- security-scan: on auth/payment/secret
  PR or /security. See skills/security-scan/SKILL.md.

## Hard rules
- Never deploy to prod without
  security-scan passing.
- Payment / auth paths require
  security-auditor power + two
  reviewers.
- Do not edit .claude/, .kiro/,
  .github/copilot/, or .vscode/
  by hand.
